text:
Morgan: Quick heads-up — planning a patch release v0.21.1 to roll back the perf regression and include the #4321 fix. Cutting the release branch and tag at 18:00 UTC today. Need: changelog entry, docs migration note, QA smoke, security scan, and a quick branch sync.

Devin: I opened a draft changelog PR (4333) with the short blurb, but I haven't cherry-picked the repo commit yet. Can someone handle the cherry-pick onto the release branch?

Devin: Suggested commands:
```
git checkout -b release/v0.21.1
git cherry-pick abc1234
git push origin release/v0.21.1
```

Sara: I'll take QA smoke on staging now. Running core e2e + perf smoke. ETA ~30m.

Alex: Docs heads-up: please add an entry to docs/changes.md and a short note in migration-guide.md about the cache invalidation tweak. I'll prep the docs PR once the tag is stable.

Nate: Running quick dependency checks (`npm audit` + `safety check`) and a vulnerability scan. Will post results in ~10m. If anything serious shows up we hold the cut.

Jin: Recommend canary at 10% traffic for 2h before full rollout. We can use routing policy `canary: 10%` in the console. If we see anomalies, auto-fallback to main.

release-bot: CI started for branch release/v0.21.1 — jobs: unit, integration, docker-build. (logs: https://ci.redwood.example/job/233)

QA: Smoke results: core endpoints ok, but embeddings endpoint regression on long prompts — reproducer attached. Failing test: `embedding-long-ctx.spec.js`

Devin: I'll look at the embeddings failure now, might be related to the KV cache flush change in abc1234.

Morgan: Priority order: (1) fix embeddings regression or (2) rollback cherry-pick. If QA green + security clear, we'll tag `v0.21.1` and merge to main. Please call out when both green.

Alex: Also pinging docs team: update the Console changelog link and the release notes template (PR #4340).

Nate: Vulnerability scan: no high/critical vulns. Two medium findings — opening follow-ups but not blockers for this patch.

Sara: Re-run smoke after Devin's patch. Will re-run e2e once cherry-pick updated.

Devin: Pushed cherry-pick fix (commit def5678) and force-updated release branch. Pushed: https://git.redwood.example/repo/release/v0.21.1

release-bot: CI restarted for release/v0.21.1 after push.

QA: Re-run smoke — all green now, embedding long prompt test passes locally and in CI.

Jin: Canary config applied: 10% for 2h. Observability dashboards set. Keeping an eye on latency and error-rate.

Morgan: Excellent. Security signoff from Nate, QA green from Sara, docs PR queued from Alex. Plan: tag and cut in 20m unless anyone objects.

Alex: No objections from docs. Added migration note and link to changelog. PR ready.

Sara: +1 from QA.

Nate: +1 security.

Morgan: Proceeding to tag in 15m. Ping here when the tag is pushed and the release notes are published. :shipit: :eyes:

Devin: Tagging now: `git tag -a v0.21.1 -m "v0.21.1: perf rollback + fix #4321"` then `git push origin v0.21.1`.

release-bot: Tag v0.21.1 pushed and release created (https://releases.redwood.example/v0.21.1). Release notes draft attached.

Morgan: Thanks team — will monitor canary and merge back to main after 2h if stable.

Alex: Reminder for follow-up: submit a short postmortem for the regression root cause and add a test to prevent recurrence.

QA: Noted. I'll add a test ticket to the sprint board.

Morgan: Closing loop: if anything spikes in canary call out in #incidents, otherwise we'll promote after 2h. :thumbsup:
